# pbs_node_config (Data Source)

Reads the settings of a Proxmox Backup Server node, which it keeps in `node.cfg` and `pbs_node_config` manages: the HTTP proxy, the sender of its mail, how long it keeps task logs, the default language, the TLS ciphers of its proxy, the consent banner, its notes and its location — every setting the node has, whether Terraform manages it or not. An unset setting is null, and PBS then uses its default. The ACME settings of the same file are left out; `pbs_node_acme` manages them.

Needs `Sys.Audit on /system`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_node_config" "this" {}

# Warn while the node sends its mail from root, its default; pbs_node_config
# sets email_from.
check "pbs_mail_sender" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_node_config.this.email_from != null
    error_message = "The PBS node sends its mail from root."
  }
}

output "pbs_task_log_max_days" {
  value = data.pbs_node_config.this.task_log_max_days
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `ciphers_tls_1_2` (String) OpenSSL cipher list the proxy offers for TLS 1.2; null for OpenSSL's defaults. The proxy reads it when it starts, reloads or loads a certificate, so a change may not be in effect yet.
- `ciphers_tls_1_3` (String) OpenSSL cipher suites the proxy offers for TLS 1.3; null for OpenSSL's defaults. The proxy reads it when it starts, reloads or loads a certificate, so a change may not be in effect yet.
- `consent_text` (String) Text of the consent banner of the login page, in Markdown, decoded from the base64 PBS stores; null when there is none, or, with a warning, when the stored text is not base64-encoded UTF-8.
- `default_lang` (String) Language of the web interface in a browser where none was chosen in it, such as `de`; null when unset, and the interface is then in English.
- `description` (String) Notes on the node, in Markdown, as PBS reads them back: every line, the last one included, ends in a line break; null when there are none.
- `email_from` (String) Address the node's mail comes from — the notifications of sendmail endpoints that set no `from_address` —; null when unset, and PBS then sends it from `root`.
- `http_proxy` (String, Sensitive) HTTP proxy PBS connects through to the internet, `[http://][user:password@]host[:port]`; null when the node has none. Sensitive, as it may hold a password, which PBS returns.
- `location` (Attributes) Where the node is, which PBS shows on a map; null when unset, and always on PBS before 4.2.1, which has no location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `task_log_max_days` (Number) Days PBS keeps the logs of finished tasks; null when unset, and PBS then keeps the last 20 rotated archives, however old.

<a id="nestedatt--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Read-Only:

- `latitude` (Number) Latitude in degrees.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude in degrees.
- `name` (String) Name of the place; null when unset.
